infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Berowra and Gordon
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 August
  • Buses replace trains between Berowra and Gordon.
  • Trains run between Gordon and the City, some to a changed timetable.
  • Buses also replace T9 Northern and Central Coast & Newcastle Line trains.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
45T1  Berowra, all stations to Gordon and return
43T1  Berowra, all stations to Hornsby and return (early morning Saturday only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Some trains run to a changed timetable. Trackwork at Wolli Creek may affect how you travel
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 2 and Thursday 3 September
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, trains between Sydenham and the City Circle run to a changed timetable.

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trackwork at Wolli Creek may affect how you travel to T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra or South Coast Line stations.
  • T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra and South Coast Line trains do not stop at Wolli Creek. Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Central for T4 Eastern Suburbs & Illawarra or South Coast Line trains.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
